label: Neon free-tier egress exhausted: archive reads failing, story URLs 5xx
detail: Postgres error 53000 on every archive read; 214 stories published 2026-08-20/21 were permanently lost and their URLs served 5xx until cleanup. Fixed by Data Cache (aeceeae) + paid Neon Launch plan 2026-08-21.

label: ISR enabled on all dynamic routes (3e8397a) — TTFB win, quota burn begins
detail: Story TTFB 557ms -> 110-125ms; ISR write/CPU burn started that paused the account five days later.

label: Vercel Hobby tier exceeded: whole site 402 for ~37 minutes (13:18-13:55 UTC)
detail: ISR Writes 238%, Fluid CPU 307%. Resolved by owner-approved Pro upgrade; burn fixed by e3baa72 (deploy hygiene, burst-gated revalidation, TTL floors).

label: Retitle wave 1 deployed (b33d8c1): homepage, categories, briefing, latest, most-covered
detail: Search-phrased titles; Google re-processes titles over days — short-term position wobble is expected, judge at 2-4 weeks.

label: News-sitemap integrity: listed URLs gated on archive standing (2515c55)
detail: Before this, Googlebot-News could fetch listed URLs that answered 500 or 308 — a direct News-trust hit while it lasted.

label: Snippet/hub deploy (674502f + 23a7b79): breadth descriptions, hub links on stories, schema honesty
detail: Multi-source descriptions, story->hub crawl paths, ItemList counts fixed, hub coverage snapshots.

label: Google de-indexed 11 of 12 indexed hub/category pages between URL-Inspection sweeps (Aug 25 -> 27), without re-crawling
detail: All 11 (/latest, /topics, /sources, /us, /canada, /politics, /business, /technology, /climate, /culture, /sports) moved indexed -> 'Crawled - currently not indexed' with lastCrawlTime unchanged (Aug 15-16) in BOTH sweeps - an index-selection re-evaluation of pre-outage copies, most plausibly the site-level trust drop from the Aug 19-27 instability propagating. Not a crawl failure: nothing to resubmit, no fetch to fix. Only / remains indexed of the 34 swept paths. Watch for reversal as clean uptime accumulates; this is a direct input to the ~Sep 22 hub-consolidation decision.

label: Redirect loop on a news-sitemap URL found, root-caused and cleared (9fd5991)
detail: Two slugs of cluster c73a14a645aa9 307ed to each other: a redirect response cached ~4.9h (no NEWS_CACHE_TAG, so revalidateTag never invalidates it, inheriting the 30-day story TTL) paired with a fresh redirect pointing back. Googlebot-News following the sitemap entry reached no page. Cleared by the deploy's ISR wipe; mechanism still live (BACKLOG item 1). seo-health.mjs now names redirect loops instead of reporting TypeError: fetch failed.

label: Archive write burst stalled: 14 h on Aug 26, 10 h on Aug 27, with every surface answering 200
detail: Measured via /api/stats/archive-sources: last archive row 2026-08-26T07:31:39Z then nothing for 14 h; 2026-08-27T07:00:30Z then nothing for 10 h. Stories published inside the windows got no permanent row (6 already answered 500 on Aug 26), /news-sitemap.xml starved from 643 entries to 132 with its newest entry 14.4 h old, and IndexNow was never pinged. Cause: the cron route returned before the persist gate whenever the dataset was fresh, and a cold instance opened the gate only in minutes 0-4/30-34, so the gate was consulted ~4x/hour at a drifting phase. Fixed 2026-08-27 by e1b4cfb.

label: Write burst restored to ~2/hour and made phase-independent (e1b4cfb)
detail: Cron route decides the burst on every tick (a fresh dataset skips the refresh only); persist-gate cold window widened to half the cycle so any scheduler beat <= 15 min must land in one. Uptime probe and seo-health now fail when the newest news-sitemap publication_date (the archive's first_seen_at) is over 4 h old, so a repeat alerts in <= 30 min instead of being found by hand.
